The Disney Kink Meme

  • Profile

Welcome to The Disney Kink Meme! We're all mad here… This collection is a prompt meme focusing on the Disney animated (and some live-action) films.

Have you ever watched a Disney movie and found yourself shipping the oddest of characters? Have you ever had a desire to see more than a chaste kiss from the romantic leads? Have you ever scoured the internet in search of Disney prince slash?

Don't be ashamed; you aren't the only one who wants it. There's a place for all of us crazies now!

The Disney Kink Meme is open to new prompts and new works.

The import of this archive to the AO3 was approved by the OTW Open Doors Committee on 20 September 2020, and began in November 2021. The archive import was completed in May 2024.

(Closed, Unmoderated, Prompt Meme Challenge)

Intro:

This collection contains works originally located at https://disney-kink.dreamwidth.org/, which were imported to the Archive of Our Own through the Open Doors Project. Participation on Dreamwidth had significantly tapered off, so the moderators wanted to move the prompt meme to a more active location. You can learn more about the import in the import announcement.

FAQ:

Most prompts and fanworks were posted anonymously to Dreamwidth, and are posted to the AO3 using the collection's archivist account. However, if you chose not to post anonymously, and if you still have access to the email on your Dreamwidth or LiveJournal profile, you should have received an email with the option to claim your works at the time they were imported. If you do not have access to that email account, or did not receive the notification, please contact the moderator at the contact email address listed above.

All unclaimed or anonymous works are imported as restricted to logged-in AO3 users only, and will be made publicly viewable after a 30-day transition period. If you claim your works before that period ended, you will need to change the restriction setting.

For questions about using the AO3, please contact Support. For questions about submitting prompts and works to The Disney Kink Meme, please contact the moderator at the email address listed above.

Rules:

1. GENERAL

Welcome! This is the Disney Kink Meme. If you somehow made your way here without knowing what a kink meme is, you can get a basic grasp on it by reading this and this.

 

1.1 General Prompting and Filling Rules

 

1. Disney Kink is only for Disney animation, including Pixar. No RPF or live-action - including the live-action Disney Channel series - are allowed. Crossovers, live-action that includes animation (ex. Enchanted) and the Disney animated television series are fine, though. All fandoms acceptable for prompting are listed here. Prompts that do not include at least one fandom on that list will be deleted. If you believe a fandom is missing from the list or should be included, you can argue it here.

2. While most kink memes are made for the purpose of anonymous requesting and filling, you do not have to be anonymous if you don't want to be.

3. Fandoms MUST be stated in the prompt. Prompts without a fandom stated will be deleted. If you say "Any" or "Various" fandoms, that's fine. (Ex. "Character A and Character B meet, smut ensues" does not contain a fandom, and even if the fandom is obvious by the characters/situation it will be deleted.)

4. You can only post one request per individual comment, but you definitely can post more than one comment. Comments with more than one prompt in it will be deleted.

5. If you are making a prompt that includes a specific pairing, state the pairing with a "/" slash. If you want a pairing specifically stated in the Lists, then you must state the pairing like that in your prompt. Example: If you say "CharacterA/CharacterB" it will be in the Lists as a pairing. If you say "CharacterA & CharacterB" it will not be put in the Lists as a pairing. If you wanted a pairing stated in the Lists/Delicious and it was not, you may report it here.

6. You are not allowed to ask or hint for a certain author in your prompt. All prompts breaking this rule will be deleted. The only way you are allowed to aim a prompt at a certain user is by Rule 7.

7. In relation to Rule 6, if you are a filler and desire certain prompts, you may prompt for more prompts. People would then post the prompts as a reply to your comment, instead of as a reply to the entry. There is a list of fillers requesting prompts here.

8. If there is a prompt that someone else made in Prompt Post 1, 2, or 3 that you would like to see filled, you are allowed to repost it in Prompt Post 4. If you are reposting a prompt you must state so in the subject line. You must also include a link to the original prompt. Reposted prompts will not be put into the Unfilled Prompts list unless the original prompt is filled.

9. Prompt Posts will remain open to prompting until they reach 6000 comments. After an entry reaches 6000 comments a new Prompt Post will open and the former Prompt Post will close to prompting. All prompts posted to a Prompt Post after it has closed will be deleted.

10. Don't second your own prompt. Any "seconds" or interested comments made on a prompt that come from the same IP address as the prompter will be deleted.

11. No ship/kink/prompt/user bashing. Be respectful. All comments bashing these will be screened or deleted.

12. IP logging is on. If you spam or troll us all comments on all posts made with your IP address will be deleted, otherwise we will not be using the knowledge of your IP address. If you feel there is a problem with your IP address, comment below.

13. If you need a mod to delete a comment in which you made a mistake or accidentally double posted, then read the section Contacting A Mod.

14. You must be familiar with our Spoiler Policy before posting.

15. As most of the Disney characters are quite young - and half are animals! - we do not have a concrete rule about underage characters. Prompts with underage characters will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and if they are deemed inappropriate they will be deleted. Child pornography is not allowed.

 

1.2 Guidelines

 

These are more what you'd call guidelines than actual rules.

You can prompt anything from non-con to non-shippy fluff. Gen, het, slash, femslash, poly, etc. Everything is welcome, except the aforementioned.

Try to go through other people's prompts and fill them or comment on other fills instead of just requesting for yourself.

Multiple fills and fills in forms other than fic (art, fanvids, etc) are encouraged.

It is very helpful to have the fandom and/or pairing and/or prompt details in the subject bar to make it easier to browse through prompts. Similarly, titling fills or simply putting "Filled" in the subject bar will make it easier for people skimming past to find them.

Many people have the Prompt Posts tracked for comments, meaning that they get an email for every comment made in the post. Try and be considerate to those people by not going overboard with prompting a lot all at once.

There is an LJ glitch in which newer comments do not show up for anonymous users. If you are not logged in, and can't find a prompt that you just made, this may be the reason why. Please log in, or wait for a day or two, to see if it will become visible before contacting a mod about it.

 

1.3 Spoiler Policy

 

1. Any prompts, fills or comments that do not follow our Spoiler Policy will be deleted.

2. Theatrically Released Movies: All prompts/fills and comments for new theatrically released animated Disney movies must have the fandom, or a spoiler warning, stated in the subject bar. There will be a message in each prompt post that states this. The message will be taken out of the post a month after the movie has premiered in almost every country it is being released in, and after that comments for it may be made without the spoiler warning.

3. Short films: Short films that are being released with theatrically released Disney movies must have the fandom, or a spoiler warning, stated in the subject bar. There will be a message in each prompt post that states this. The message will be taken out of the post a month after the theatrically released movie premieres, and after that comments for it may be made without the spoiler warning.

4. Strait-to-DVD, Television, Comics, TV movies, etc: There is not a required spoiler warning for strait-to-DVD or television movies, television shows, or books/comics/games pertaining to Disney fandoms, but it's a good idea to have one in the subject bar anyway, just to be nice.

5. Non-Disney: There is no required spoiler warning for non-Disney properties, but, once again, it's a good idea to include one anyway if you deem it necessary.
